critical_code_review_comments: financial_service.adjust_agent_balance performs 3 sequential writes without a transaction (documented — no replica set). Phase 8 reconciliation task planned. For now, if the process crashes between insert_one(txn) and update_one(profile), the ledger and cached balance diverge; consider at minimum a compensating rollback path or wrapping in a session/txn when replica-set is available.

AdminAgentsPage stores search input state locally but only commits on Enter; consider a debounced auto-apply so users don't wonder why typing didn't filter (or add a Search button). Currently discoverable via testing only.
admin_dashboard.dashboard() runs 8+ sequential count_documents calls; when catalog grows, consider $facet aggregation or Promise.all-equivalent (asyncio.gather).

recent_audit projection is fine but leaks 'before'/'after' via later listing endpoints — ensure PII (email/phone) staying in audit before/after is acceptable per privacy policy (currently OK for internal admin).
AdminShell 'soon' items still receive :hover styles; minor UX: disable pointer events entirely.

AdjustBalanceDialog sends amount as string; backend Pydantic Decimal parses it OK, but consider client-side rejection of amount<=0 so the round-trip is avoided (currently HTML min=0.01 helps but not enforced on submit).
